title: The Hoodie Knew The Code 🤖 Ep.2
endcard: FINALE: THE NAME ON THE TAG

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: BRO! BRO!! [beat] The math final is GONE! [beat] Like — GONE gone! [beat] Security-cameras-gone!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 2 a.m. One camera. One hoodie. [beat] And a door opened… with a KEY. [beat] Nobody broke in last night.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Everybody in my office. NOW. [beat] Or Monday's exam becomes HARDCORE MODE.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Why are you all looking at ME?! [beat] I was in ranked matches till 4 a.m.! [beat] FORTY witnesses!

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Checked. You're clean. [beat] You lost eleven times.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: …You did NOT have to say the number.

lines.speaker: mim
lines.text: Fine — I was at school that night. [beat] Painting. Alone. [beat] Don't judge my process.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Her paint is blue. [beat] The staff-room dust? White. Chalk. [beat] She never went near that room.

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: So we need chalk-dusted shoes… [beat] and a key that shouldn't exist. [beat] This school has DEPTHS.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Children — only three keys open that door. [beat] Mine. The principal's. [beat] And the office spare.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Then it's simple! Check the hook! [beat] Key there — someone copied it! [beat] Key gone—

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: It's gone. [beat] The hook is EMPTY. [beat] But the name tag… is still hanging there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every eye turned to that little tag. [beat] And the name on it… [beat] froze the whole school.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for the finale! [beat] That name made NO sense — [beat] NOBODY saw it coming!
